name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts with static hosting, redirects, security headers, rate limiting, firewall rules, Fail2ban, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis on port 6379 with authentication and logging, and applies the required Redis configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application in a virtual environment, provisions its database and user, writes environment configuration, and runs Uvicorn through systemd.
